title: Lid Just Doesn't Create Airtight Seal
text:
Lid Just Doesn't Create Airtight Seal. I selected this cookie jar with the idea of keeping it on the counter with baked things in it. We didn't have a cookie car and have been using a plastic bowl with a silicone lid to keep things fresh, and this looked like a decent solution. Unfortunately it falls short - the top does not seal properly.

I like the overall design. The ceramic jar itself is a good size, sufficient to hold a pack of store-bought cookies comfortably, and the lid rests on top. The lid has a silicone gasket that is designed to create a seal when the lid is pressed down, locking in the air and preventing the stuff inside from getting stale. The jar itself seems to be well made and I did not find any burrs, pits, bubbles or uncovered spots in the glaze, either on the jar or the lid.

The problem is that the lid never seals. I tried multiple times to get the lid to create the airtight seal and it just won't do it. I even tried flipping the gasket around, thinking that it had been put on inside out or upside down, but this didn't help at all and the lid still would not seal. After trying to get the lid to seal I picked up the jar and inverted it, and the lid fell right off (I was careful to do this such that I could catch the lid so it would not break).

I wanted to like this jar but the fact that it will not seal is a big issue. I can use it for kitchen utensils without the lid, but for a cookie jar this one doesn't cut it.
